# References

- [doi:10.2307/1412159](https://doi.org/10.2307/1412159): the rank correlation coefficient rho of co-varying pairs (Spearman, Am J Psychol 15:72, 1904)
- [doi:10.5351/CSAM.2015.22.6.665](https://doi.org/10.5351/CSAM.2015.22.6.665): ppcor, whose pcor.test(method = 'spearman') the partial correlation given the run level reproduces (Kim, Commun Stat Appl Methods 22:665, 2015)
- [doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1995.tb02031.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.2517-6161.1995.tb02031.x): the step-up adjustment behind q, within each fdr\_family (Benjamini and Hochberg, J R Stat Soc B 57:289, 1995)
